THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

THE SCENE

You help at the science museum after school. Tomorrow a new room about glaciers in Bolivia opens. One wall shows a forecast, and it is still empty. You need four numbers to finish it. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

This room is about Chacaltaya, a glacier in Bolivia. In 1939 people built a place to ski on it. Scientists said it would melt by 2015. It was gone by 2009.
